name: agent-engineering
description: Design the structures agents work through. Task graphs: split work by its real dependencies, run the diamond pattern (parallel workers, separate verifiers, one owned merge), apply the stop rule and human gates. Loops at two timescales: state objects, context isolation, and convergence rules within a run; recurring operational loops (autonomy ladder, budgets, kill switches, maker/checker) on a schedule. Knowledge graphs: the 9-stage pipeline (ontology, extraction, fusion, GraphRAG serving) for durable agent memory. Context engineering: attention budget, degradation patterns, compression/optimization, and tool design. Harness engineering: the runtime around the model — the six-layer audit surface, tool-surface subtraction, boundary enforcement with validators and hooks, backpressure, and the engineer-against-repeats rule. Ships an Agent Engineer agent, six skills, and sixteen workflow commands.
